content_of_post_to_answer: My 13-year-old son is depressed. I have taken away his phone. What should I do?
answer: Taking away the phone may remove one source of distress, but it may also remove one of the few places where a teenager feels connected. The bigger question is not “phone or no phone” but “what role is the phone playing?” If it is replacing sleep, school, or real relationships, limits may help. If it is his escape from loneliness, punishment can deepen the isolation. A depressed child usually needs curiosity before correction; understand the pain behind the behavior before trying to control the behavior.
